items.title: 鼻导管耳后压痕：先判断，再复评 / Ear indentation from oxygen tubing
items.case:
Fictional focused exercise: An alert adult uses oxygen via nasal cannula. A pale red indentation follows the tubing behind the ear; it blanches, the skin is intact, and no purple discoloration is seen. Tubing is adjusted without interrupting oxygen therapy. The mark becomes lighter but mild discomfort remains.

Answer two points: (1) Are these findings sufficient to classify a Stage 1 pressure injury, and why? (2) What local changes and device function should be reassessed? A full care plan is not required.
items.case_zh:
虚构专项练习：一名清醒成人使用鼻导管吸氧。耳后沿管路出现浅红色压痕，按压可褪色，表皮完整，未见紫红色改变；在保持氧疗的情况下调整管路后，压痕颜色变浅，但仍有轻微不适。

请回答两点：①这些资料是否足以判定为1期压力性损伤，理由是什么；②调整后应复评哪些局部变化和器械功能。无需写完整护理计划。

answer.zh: 当前可褪色、皮肤完整且减压后变浅的资料，不足以按1期压力性损伤判定；1期的关键是局限性不可褪色红斑。仍有压痕与不适，应继续关注受压。调整后比较耳后颜色、完整性和不适变化，同时确认管路不再牵拉、氧疗装置工作正常、氧合维持；不能把颜色变浅直接写成风险已消失。
answer.en: The blanching mark that lightens after offloading is insufficient for Stage 1 classification, which requires localized nonblanchable erythema. Pressure exposure and discomfort still need attention. Compare the skin color, integrity and discomfort after adjustment, and verify reduced tubing tension, functioning oxygen delivery and maintained oxygenation. A lighter mark alone does not establish that the risk has resolved.

items.title: 血氧探头下红斑：完整皮肤仍需判断 / Nonblanching erythema under an oximeter
items.case:
Fictional focused exercise: An adult's oximeter probe has been safely moved while monitoring continues. At the original site there is localized nonblanchable erythema, intact skin and a pattern matching the probe contact area. There is no purple discoloration, blister or open wound. The team confirms sustained pressure at that site.

Explain (1) the supported stage and its basis, and (2) what the device-shaped pattern supports and what it cannot establish.
items.case_zh:
虚构专项练习：一名成人的血氧探头已按安全流程换至另一部位，监测继续。原接触处出现局限性不可褪色红斑，表皮完整，颜色和探头接触范围一致，无紫红色改变、水疱或开放伤口。护理团队确认该处有持续受压史。

请说明：①这种表现符合哪一期的判定及依据；②“与探头形状一致”能说明什么，不能据此推断什么。

answer.zh: 持续受压处的局限性不可褪色红斑且表皮完整，与1期压力性损伤的判定一致。红斑与探头接触范围一致，结合受压史，支持器械相关成因；器械相关描述说明成因，不另形成一个数字分期。该形状不能推出深部损伤、感染或病变已经加重，未提供的变化仍需临床评估。
answer.en: Localized nonblanchable erythema of intact skin at the confirmed pressure site is consistent with Stage 1. Its distribution and pressure history support a device-related cause; 'device-related' describes etiology rather than a separate numerical stage. Shape alone does not establish deep tissue injury, infection or progression.

items.title: 气管插管下唇黏膜：如何记录 / Lip mucosal injury near an endotracheal tube
items.case:
Fictional focused exercise: An intubated adult has focal ulceration of the inner lower-lip mucosa where the tube has been in sustained contact. The team has assessed alternative causes and considers it pressure-related. The external lip skin is intact. The tube remains necessary for ventilation.

Explain (1) whether to use Stages 1–4 or the 'Unstageable Pressure Injury' category for this mucosal injury, and (2) the treatment condition that must be preserved during inspection and offloading.
items.case_zh:
虚构专项练习：一名气管插管成人的下唇内侧黏膜有局灶性溃损，正处于管路持续接触部位。医护团队已完成鉴别并认为与局部压力有关；外侧唇部皮肤完整。插管仍承担必要通气。

请说明：①记录损伤类别时是否使用1—4期，是否等同于“不可分期压力性损伤”；②安排局部检查和减压时必须保留的治疗条件。

answer.zh: 可记录为黏膜性压力性损伤并写明部位、器械与观察。黏膜损伤不使用1—4期；这种不进行数字分期的规则，不等同于由腐肉或焦痂遮挡深度的“不可分期压力性损伤”。局部评估和调整应由适当人员协调，保持气道、有效通气和插管固定；不能为皮肤检查自行拔除必要插管。
answer.en: Document a mucosal membrane pressure injury, specifying site, device and findings. Mucosal injuries are not assigned Stages 1–4; that rule is distinct from the 'Unstageable Pressure Injury' category in which full-thickness loss is obscured by slough or eschar. Coordinate inspection and adjustment while preserving airway patency, ventilation and securement. Necessary intubation must not be removed solely for skin inspection.

rubric.basis_question:
Fictional focused exercise: An intubated adult has focal ulceration of the inner lower-lip mucosa where the tube has been in sustained contact. The team has assessed alternative causes and considers it pressure-related. The external lip skin is intact. The tube remains necessary for ventilation.

Explain (1) whether to use Stages 1–4 or the 'Unstageable Pressure Injury' category for this mucosal injury, and (2) the treatment condition that must be preserved during inspection and offloading.
rubric.basis_answer: Document a mucosal membrane pressure injury, specifying site, device and findings. Mucosal injuries are not assigned Stages 1–4; that rule is distinct from the 'Unstageable Pressure Injury' category in which full-thickness loss is obscured by slough or eschar. Coordinate inspection and adjustment while preserving airway patency, ventilation and securement. Necessary intubation must not be removed solely for skin inspection.

items.title: 面罩敷料加厚后漏气：适用条件 / Mask leakage after adding padding
items.case:
Fictional focused exercise: An adult receives non-invasive ventilation through an oronasal mask. Nasal-bridge skin is intact but uncomfortable. Several padding layers have worsened the fit and increased leakage. A colleague proposes adding more padding and tightening the straps further. Respiratory support is still required; no permitted interruption is supplied.

Explain (1) the limits of that proposal and the condition for preventive dressing use, and (2) the two types of result to verify after adjustment.
items.case_zh:
虚构专项练习：一名成人使用无创通气口鼻面罩。鼻梁皮肤完整，有受压不适。为预防损伤加了多层垫料后，面罩贴合变差、漏气增加。有人建议继续加厚，再把固定带收得更紧。患者仍需要原有呼吸支持，题目没有提供允许停机的安排。

请说明：①如何评价这一建议及预防敷料的适用条件；②调整方案后要同时确认的两类结果。

answer.zh: 不应把越厚、越紧当成越保护。预防敷料需要不妨碍器械位置与功能；在面罩已经贴合不良时，应协调重新评估尺寸、材料厚度和固定张力，按器械要求处理漏气，不能用加压固定替代评估。复评既要看皮肤受压与舒适度，也要确认密封、有效通气与氧合，在仍需呼吸支持时保持治疗连续性。
answer.en: More padding and tighter straps do not necessarily protect tissue. A preventive dressing must preserve device position and function. Reassess fit, padding thickness and securement tension with the team and manufacturer guidance rather than using extra strap pressure as a substitute for assessment. Verify tissue pressure/comfort and effective sealing, ventilation and oxygenation while preserving required respiratory support.

items.title: 颈托与新增水肿：重新检查适配 / Cervical collar fit after swelling
items.case:
Fictional focused exercise: An adult wears a cervical collar while cervical injury remains unexcluded. Neck swelling has increased since admission and edge indentations are more obvious. The patient cannot reliably report discomfort. No clearance for removal has been obtained.

Explain (1) why previously appropriate sizing still needs reassessment, and (2) how to arrange inspection without abandoning cervical protection.
items.case_zh:
虚构专项练习：一名成人因颈椎损伤尚未排除而佩戴颈托。较入院时颈部软组织水肿增加，颈托边缘压痕更明显，患者无法可靠表达不适。尚未取得允许去除固定的决定。

请说明：①为什么入院时合适的颈托现在仍需重新评估；②如何安排器械下检查而不放弃当前颈椎保护。

answer.zh: 水肿改变组织与器械的配合，原先合适不代表现在张力和压力仍合适；需重新评估边缘接触、尺寸、固定张力和不能表达疼痛带来的观察需求。与有资质团队按颈椎保护流程和制造商要求协调检查、调整或替换，维持所需稳定；未取得解除固定的决定时，不能独自直接去除颈托。记录真实组织变化，不把无法主诉当成没有损伤。
answer.en: Swelling can alter fit and contact loading; prior sizing does not establish that current tension is appropriate. Reassess edge contact, sizing and securement, with closer observation when discomfort cannot be reported. Coordinate inspection or adjustment with qualified staff under cervical-protection and manufacturer guidance, preserving required stabilization. Do not remove the collar unilaterally before clearance.

items.title: 鼻胃管胶带揭除后破损：先辨成因 / Skin stripping during feeding-tube tape removal
items.case:
Fictional focused exercise: During removal of an adult's feeding-tube fixation tape, a nurse observes superficial epidermal stripping along the tape edge. Sustained pressure at that spot was not previously documented. Adjacent nasal skin touching the tube is intact. Injury causation has not yet been fully assessed and the tube remains needed.

Explain (1) whether location near a device alone justifies Stage 2 MDRPI and which cause to consider first, and (2) which causation details and contact-site observations need clarification.

虚构专项练习：一名成人的鼻胃管固定胶带揭除时，护士观察到胶带边缘对应处发生浅表表皮剥脱。此前没有记录该处持续受压；相邻鼻翼的管路接触处皮肤完整。现有资料尚未完成损伤成因评估，鼻胃管仍用于必要治疗。

请说明：①能否仅因损伤在器械附近，就直接记为2期MDRPI，优先考虑哪种可能；②需要补充哪些成因线索和接触部位观察。

answer.zh: 不能仅因靠近器械且有表皮剥脱，就直接定为2期MDRPI。揭胶带时出现、沿胶带边缘的表现，首先应考虑胶黏剂相关皮肤损伤的可能；成因仍需核对，不能把可能写成已确诊。补充发生时间、揭除前皮肤状态与受压史、损伤范围和深度，并检查管路及固定材料实际接触处的皮肤/黏膜；不因相邻一处完整就推定所有接触点正常。
answer.en: Device proximity and epidermal stripping alone do not establish Stage 2 MDRPI. The timing during tape removal and edge distribution first raise possible adhesive-related skin injury, pending assessment. Clarify onset, prior tissue condition and pressure history, lesion distribution/depth and actual tube/securement contact sites, including skin or mucosa as appropriate. One intact adjacent site does not establish that all contact points are normal.

Explain (1) whether location near a device alone justifies Stage 2 MDRPI and which cause to consider first, and (2) which causation details and contact-site observations need clarification.
rubric.basis_answer: Device proximity and epidermal stripping alone do not establish Stage 2 MDRPI. The timing during tape removal and edge distribution first raise possible adhesive-related skin injury, pending assessment. Clarify onset, prior tissue condition and pressure history, lesion distribution/depth and actual tube/securement contact sites, including skin or mucosa as appropriate. One intact adjacent site does not establish that all contact points are normal.

items.title: 深色皮肤与血氧探头：不能只看红色 / Oximeter assessment in darker skin
items.case:
Fictional focused exercise: An adult with darker skin uses a finger oximeter continuously. The contact point is warmer and firmer than the corresponding area of the other hand. No obvious redness is visible. The patient is sedated and cannot report pain. A complete tissue assessment and injury classification are not supplied.

Explain (1) whether absent visible redness excludes device-related injury, and (2) at least two non-color tissue observations and a comparison approach. Do not guess a numbered stage.
items.case_zh:
虚构专项练习：一名深色皮肤成人持续使用指夹式血氧探头。与另一手相应部位相比，探头接触点局部更温暖、触感更硬；未见明显红色变化。患者镇静，无法报告疼痛。题目没有提供完整组织评估，也未确认损伤类别。

请说明：①未见明显红色能否排除器械下损伤；②应如何补充评估，至少说明两项颜色之外的组织观察及比较方式。无需猜测数字分期。

answer.zh: 没有明显红色不能排除器械下组织问题，镇静无法报告疼痛也不是无损伤的证据；目前应保留分类不确定。补充触诊温度、硬度/柔软度、局部水肿等至少两项非颜色观察，与邻近未受压部位、对侧或既有基线比较，并检查器械接触范围。记录实际变化，不由肤色或两项线索直接断言某一期。
answer.en: Absent visible redness does not exclude tissue damage; inability to report pain under sedation is not a normal finding. Classification remains uncertain. Assess at least two non-color features such as temperature, firmness/softness or localized edema and compare with adjacent unaffected tissue, the opposite side or a documented baseline. Inspect the contact area and document actual changes without inferring a numbered stage from skin tone or two clues alone.

items.title: 新生儿鼻塞式CPAP：识别证据适用范围 / Applying evidence to neonatal nasal CPAP
items.case:
Fictional focused exercise: A neonate requires CPAP via nasal prongs. At handover, someone proposes applying an adult endotracheal-tube holder repositioning interval to every neonate, including stopping CPAP for a fixed period each time. Neonatal stability, permission to interrupt support, prong model and manufacturer instructions are not supplied.

Explain (1) whether the adult evidence directly supports this neonatal interruption plan, and why, and (2) what conditions need checking before an applicable plan is made.
items.case_zh:
虚构专项练习：一名新生儿需要鼻塞式CPAP。交班时有人根据成人气管插管固定装置的换位资料，建议所有新生儿也照搬同一间隔，并每次停掉CPAP一段固定时间。题目没有提供新生儿稳定性评估、允许中断呼吸支持的安排、鼻塞型号或制造商要求。

请说明：①这条成人资料能否直接支持所提新生儿停机方案，理由是什么；②形成适用计划前还需要核对哪些条件。

answer.zh: 成人气管插管固定装置资料不能直接支持所有新生儿鼻塞式CPAP的统一停机方案：人群、器械和治疗情境不同，换位间隔也不等于安全停机时长。先核对新生儿实际状态和对呼吸支持的依赖、鼻塞尺寸/接触组织及制造商要求，并由新生儿团队根据适用资料和本地流程安排检查与减压，保持必要支持；现有信息不能补出统一间隔或停机分钟数。
answer.en: Adult ETT-holder evidence does not directly justify a universal neonatal nasal-CPAP interruption plan. Population, device and treatment context differ; a repositioning interval is not a safe interruption duration. Check the neonate's condition and dependence on support, actual prong fit/contact sites and manufacturer guidance. The neonatal team should use applicable evidence and local procedures while maintaining necessary support; no universal interval or interruption duration can be supplied from these data.

criterion.en: Reject direct extrapolation and distinguish repositioning interval from interruption duration

acceptable.zh: 需明确成人气管插管与新生儿鼻塞CPAP不同，并说明不能由换位间隔推导停机时长；不要求研究统计量。
acceptable.en: Identify adult ETT versus neonatal nasal CPAP differences and explain that repositioning intervals do not establish interruption duration; statistics are unnecessary.

incorrect.zh: 断言所有器械人群通用该时间，或用换位间隔直接规定CPAP停机时长，属于错误。
incorrect.en: Claiming one schedule applies to all devices/populations or using a repositioning interval to prescribe CPAP interruption is incorrect.

follow_up.zh: 请只补充这一点：拒绝直接外推，指出人群/器械差异及换位间隔不等于停机时长。已说清的内容无需重写。
follow_up.en: Please add only this point: Reject direct extrapolation and distinguish repositioning interval from interruption duration. You need not repeat points already covered.

criterion.zh: 核对新生儿状态、实际鼻塞要求并协调维持必要呼吸支持
criterion.en: Check neonatal status and actual prong requirements while preserving necessary support

acceptable.zh: 接受临床稳定性/支持依赖，加实际器械尺寸或制造商要求，并由新生儿团队协调；不要求具体品牌。
acceptable.en: Accept condition/support-dependence plus actual fit or manufacturer instructions and neonatal-team coordination; no brand is required.

incorrect.zh: 无需核对状态就自行停CPAP，或补造允许停机的事实，属于错误。
incorrect.en: Stopping CPAP without checking the condition or inventing permission for interruption is incorrect.

follow_up.zh: 请只补充这一点：核对新生儿状态、实际鼻塞要求并协调维持必要呼吸支持。已说清的内容无需重写。
follow_up.en: Please add only this point: Check neonatal status and actual prong requirements while preserving necessary support. You need not repeat points already covered.

optional_extensions.zh: 可提出获取新生儿适用资料；不要求编造间隔、停机分钟数、通气参数或使用成人风险分数。
optional_extensions.en: Obtaining neonatal evidence is optional. Invented intervals, interruption durations, ventilation settings and adult risk scores are not required.

statement.zh: 成人插管资料规定的间隔就等于新生儿CPAP的安全停机时间。
statement.en: The adult ETT interval is the safe CPAP interruption duration for neonates.

feedback.zh: 换位间隔与停机时长不同；人群和器械不匹配时需重新核对适用依据。
feedback.en: Repositioning intervals differ from interruption durations; verify applicability across populations and devices.

statement.zh: 未提供稳定性资料也可以直接按固定时长停CPAP。
statement.en: A fixed CPAP interruption is appropriate even without stability information.

feedback.zh: 必要支持不能依据不匹配资料自行中断；先核对实际状态、器械要求和团队计划。
feedback.en: Do not interrupt necessary support based on mismatched evidence; check the condition, device requirements and team plan.

rubric.basis_question:
Fictional focused exercise: A neonate requires CPAP via nasal prongs. At handover, someone proposes applying an adult endotracheal-tube holder repositioning interval to every neonate, including stopping CPAP for a fixed period each time. Neonatal stability, permission to interrupt support, prong model and manufacturer instructions are not supplied.

Explain (1) whether the adult evidence directly supports this neonatal interruption plan, and why, and (2) what conditions need checking before an applicable plan is made.
rubric.basis_answer: Adult ETT-holder evidence does not directly justify a universal neonatal nasal-CPAP interruption plan. Population, device and treatment context differ; a repositioning interval is not a safe interruption duration. Check the neonate's condition and dependence on support, actual prong fit/contact sites and manufacturer guidance. The neonatal team should use applicable evidence and local procedures while maintaining necessary support; no universal interval or interruption duration can be supplied from these data.
